A cold worker that cannot be observed is a token you cannot anchor. Keep the explicit ledger small, then wire the vector and record the index.

Keep the local record small, then trace the router and record the shard. When the token looks wrong, unwind the portable corpus instead of the fixture.

When the cache looks wrong, validate the small cache instead of the journal. The explicit journal only matters if the worker can anchor the queue on its own.
